releaseNotes: Adds one strict public-calendar contract for future GitHub Actions, the PWA, and Scriptable caching.
Rejects empty, suspiciously small, malformed, unordered, duplicate, wrong-year, and incorrect-boundary calendar candidates.
Preserves the previous validated calendar as a recoverable last-known-good copy before installing an update.
Adds portable private-data exclusions and a single plain-language project verification command.
